items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: I was marching with a guy named Son Johnson... So I was standing next, I was marching with a guy named Son Johnson... we messed around and drinking all that liquor

ctx.x: You know one time I played a carnival parade, and we were supposed to follow Rex. Yeah. And the guy, the president of the club, it was a white club too, and they gave us a fifth of whiskey. So I was standing next, I was marching with a guy named Son Johnson, have you heard of Son Johnson? Yeah. He was on this side of me, and I remember playing the horn, take me a drink, play the horn, give him the, because he couldn't carry the whiskey and play his horn too, because you have to have two hands to play the…
